prompt: These sounds have been generated by recording the output of one or multiple guitar effect pedal with an input of a 10ms white noise burst. If the pedal is mono, the sample is as well and vice versa. The signal generated in Ableton Live has been sent over MOTU (UltraLite-mk3 Hybrid) through a Radial Reamper, the pedal and a Radial JDI back to the MOTU and recorded in Ableton (which was just handy for this). No more processing have been done to the samples which are in 24/48. Initially made for Max for Live's Convolution Reverb.
